# Resolvia
> Retention-Engineered Video Editing Agency & Post-Production Studio for High-Growth Creators, Media Brands, and Venture-Backed Founders.

Resolvia (https://theresolvia.com) is a video post-production agency specializing in high-retention editing, narrative pacing architecture, sonic foley design, and high-velocity workflow pipelines for YouTube, Shorts, and Reels creators.

## Primary Canonical Pages
- [Home & Overview](https://theresolvia.com/): Official studio showcase, featured client edits (50M+ combined views), 48-hour sprint workflow, and core post-production capabilities.
- [Client Work & Case Studies](https://theresolvia.com/work/): Concrete project breakdowns, before/after retention curves, subscriber velocity metrics (80K to 850K subs case study), and portfolio reels.
- [Editorial & Retention Science Hub](https://theresolvia.com/blog.html): Reverse-engineered YouTube retention case studies, hook psychology, pacing curves, and audio foley architecture.
- [Join the Editor Roster](https://theresolvia.com/careers.html): Global career opportunities for top-tier NLE editors, motion designers, and sound engineers.
- [Pre-Release Security Vault](https://theresolvia.com/security.html): Enterprise-grade bilateral NDAs, zero-leak raw footage vault, and encrypted post-production pipelines.
- [Terms of Production](https://theresolvia.com/terms.html): Production agreements, media usage rights, turnaround SLAs, and retainer conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://theresolvia.com/privacy.html): Pre-release media confidentiality, data handling, and client asset governance.

## Products & Tools
- [Super Search](https://theresolvia.com/super-search/): Search and discover viral video formats and references for your niche.
- [Resolvia MCP](https://theresolvia.com/mcp/): Use Resolvia inside Claude and ChatGPT to find viral videos, adapt their script, and edit your video from the chat.
- [Resolvia Copilot](https://theresolvia.com/copilot/): Talk to Resolvia Copilot to find the viral videos for your product, write your script, and edit your video.
- [Script Studio](https://theresolvia.com/script-studio/): Turn a viral video into your own script in two clicks: same hook, same structure, rewritten for your product.
- [Auto Editing](https://theresolvia.com/auto-editing/): Drop your footage and get a short video edited with cuts, captions, b-roll, and motion in one click.

## Specialized Service Landing Pages
- [YouTube Video Editing](https://theresolvia.com/services/youtube-video-editing/): Retention-engineered YouTube long-form post-production, structural narrative cuts, Fairlight audio mastering, 3D motion graphics, and high-CTR thumbnail packaging.
- [Short-Form Video Editing](https://theresolvia.com/services/short-form-video-editing/): High-velocity vertical video editing for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts with kinetic typography, sound FX, and sub-3-second scroll interrupts.
- [Podcast Video Editing](https://theresolvia.com/services/podcast-video-editing/): Multi-camera video podcast editing, broadcast loudness mastering (-14 LUFS), and 10-15 viral vertical clips per episode.
- [Video Ad Editing](https://theresolvia.com/services/video-ad-editing/): Direct-response video ad editing, multiple hook testing variations, UGC polish, and ROAS optimization for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Ads.

## Target Audience Portals
- [For Creators & YouTubers](https://theresolvia.com/for/creators/): Dedicated editing team handling 4-8 uploads per month with 48-hour SLAs so creators can focus 100% on filming and ideation.
- [For Businesses & B2B SaaS](https://theresolvia.com/for/businesses/): Scalable post-production for corporate webinars, product demos, founder thought leadership, and customer stories.
- [For Marketing Agencies](https://theresolvia.com/for/agencies/): Confidential white-label video post-production partner with wholesale margins, guaranteed SLAs, and Frame.io integration.
